evidence: Estimated Gage R&R is 48.80% of study variation, 64.10% of tolerance, with 2 distinct categories.
The released records describe percent void area for joints... not honing-line bore roughness
Consequently, the void-fraction results are observations from an unreliable gauge, not confirmed product quality.
Any process capability statement below is therefore conditional and must not be used as an independent acceptance conclusion.
reviews.rationale: The measurement system clearly fails (Gage R&R % Study Variation of 48.8% and NDC of 2), strictly forbidding substantive use of the measurements. Moreover, the dataset provided covers an entirely different characteristic (void fraction instead of bore roughness). The report accurately identifies both critical issues, stops the substantive analysis appropriately, and perfectly restricts its subsequent calculations as conditional descriptive statistics while explicitly withholding unwarranted conclusions.
reviews.numerical_check: Verified MSA metrics against standard criteria (48.8% Study Variation > 30% limit; NDC 2 < 5 limit) based on self-reported outputs, confirming gauge failure.
